description: Insert the `vmark` rules `visimark_infer` proposed. Pass the plan you were given, with any proposal you rejected removed. Refused if the document changed since the plan was computed, and refused entirely unless the operator started the server with `--allow-write` and the host declared a root.

path.description: The document to write. There is nothing to apply to a string.

plan.description: The result of `visimark_infer`, unedited apart from dropping entries you rejected.

name: visimark_infer_apply
title: Apply proposed VisiMark rules
